name: sorteo-amigo-invisible
description: Web navideña de sorteos de Amigo Invisible con envío por WhatsApp y MySQL local (XAMPP/phpMyAdmin)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c green,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.cf:dev: npm run build --prefix frontend && npx wrangler pages dev frontend/dist --compatibility-date=2026-01-01
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run build --prefix frontend && npx wrangler pages deploy frontend/dist --project-name=amigo-invisible-nocturno
